```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyr)
Canopy<- BES_Data_Sheet_Entered_data_CanopyCover
Veg<-BES_Data_Sheet_Entered_data_Veg
Air<-BES_Data_Sheet_Entered_AirQ
Canopy$`Canopy open %`<-as.numeric(Canopy$`Canopy open %`)
Canopy$`Round`<-as.character(Canopy$Round)
Canopy$`Site`<-as.character(Canopy$Site)
Canopy<-rename(Canopy, Canopy_open='Canopy open %')
Canopy_av<-Canopy%>%
  select(Round,Site, Corner,Canopy_open)%>%
  group_by(Round, Site)%>%
  mutate(Open_av=mean(as.numeric(Canopy_open), na.rm=TRUE))%>%
  select(-Corner, -Canopy_open)%>%
  unique()
Canopy_av<-na.omit(Canopy_av)%>%
  filter(!Round==5)

Air<-Air%>%
  mutate(mean_temp=(Temp_Start+Temp_end)/2)%>%
  mutate(mean_PM2.5=(PM2.5_Start+PM2.5_end)/2)
Temp<-Air%>%
  select(Round, Site, mean_temp, mean_PM2.5)%>%
  filter(!Round==5)


Veg <- Veg %>%
  mutate(Cover_Type = case_match(Cover_Type,
    "L-C"  ~ "L-B",
    "R-C" ~ "R-B",
    "LN" ~ "L-N",
    "L-A" ~ "L-B",
    "Ln"~ "L-N",
    "RB"~ "R-B",
     "V-n"~ "V-N",
     "B-G"~ "BG",
    
    .default = Cover_Type # Keep everything else the same
  ))

Veg_cover<-Veg%>%
  group_by(Site, Quadrat, Cover_Type,Transect, Round)%>%
  summarise(Cover_prop=sum(as.numeric(Cover_Prop)))

Veg_cover_mean<-Veg_cover%>%
  group_by(Site, Cover_Type)%>%
   summarise(Cover_prop=mean(as.numeric(Cover_prop)))

Veg_cover_wide<-Veg_cover_mean%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=Cover_Type, values_from=Cover_prop)

Veg_cover_wide<-Veg_cover_wide%>%
  filter(!Site=="NA")%>%
  select(-"NA")
#if there is no data there that means that the cover is 0 percent
Veg_cover_wide[is.na(Veg_cover_wide)]<- 0

```

```{r}
Canopy_av$Round<-as.numeric(Canopy_av$Round)
Temp$Round<-as.numeric(Temp$Round)
Canopy_av$Site<-as.numeric(Canopy_av$Site)
Temp$Site<-as.numeric(Temp$Site)
canopy_temp<-left_join(Canopy_av, Temp, by= join_by(Round==Round, Site==Site))
canopy_temp<-canopy_temp%>%
  filter(mean_temp<100)
lm<-lmer(mean_temp~Open_av+(1|Round), data=canopy_temp)

summary(lm)
lm_pm<-lmer(mean_PM2.5~Open_av+(1|Round), data=canopy_temp)
summary(lm_pm)
lm_pm<-lmer(mean_PM2.5~mean_temp+(1|Round), data=canopy_temp)
summary(lm_pm)




plot(canopy_temp$mean_temp~canopy_temp$Open_av)


species_count<-BES_Data_Sheet_Species_List%>%
  select(Site, Species_count, 'Site Type')%>%
  na.omit()
species_count<-rename(species_count, Site_type='Site Type')
species_count<-species_count%>%
  group_by(Site_type)%>%
  mutate(mean_sp_count=mean(Species_count))
lm_sp<-lm(Species_count~Site_type, data=species_count)

summary(lm_sp)
anova(lm_sp)
em<-emmeans(lm_sp, ~Site_type)
pairs(em)
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data=species_count, aes(x=Site_type, y=Species_count))+
  geom_boxplot()

site_av<-canopy_temp%>%
  group_by(Site)%>%
  summarise(Open_canopy=mean(Open_av),
            Temp=mean(mean_temp), 
            PM2.5=mean(mean_PM2.5))
canopy_temp_sp<-left_join(site_av, species_count, by= join_by( Site==Site))

canopy_temp_sp<-canopy_temp_sp%>%
  select(-Species_count)
data<-left_join(canopy_temp_sp, Veg_cover_wide, by= join_by( Site==Site))

cordata<-data%>%
  select(-Species_count, -Site, -Site_type)
library(corrplot)
sitecorrelation<-cor(cordata, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
p.mat <- cor.mtest(sitecorrelation)$p
corrplot(sitecorrelation,type = "upper",  p.mat=p.mat, sig.level = 0.05,  na.label = "square", na.label.col = "grey")


```
